layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Kai Zhu, Li Chen, Dianshuo Li, Yunxiang Cao, Jun Cheng, Senior Member, IEEE

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract—Curvilinear structure segmentation (CSS) is essen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tial in various domains, including medical imaging, landscape

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: analysis, industrial surface inspection, and plant analysis. While

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: existing methods achieve high performance within specific do-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mains, their generalizability is limited. On the other hand,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large-scale models such as Segment Anything Model (SAM)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: exhibit strong generalization but are not optimized for curvi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linear structures. Existing adaptations of SAM primarily focus

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on general object segmentation and lack specialized design

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for CSS tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose the Universal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear structure Segmentation (UCS) model, which adapts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM to CSS tasks while further enhancing its cross-domain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generalization. UCS features a novel encoder architecture in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tegrating a pretrained SAM encoder with two innovations: a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Sparse Adapter, strategically inserted to inherit the pre-trained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM encoder's generalization capability while minimizing the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: number of fine-tuning parameters, and a Prompt Generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module, which leverages Fast Fourier Transform with a high-pass

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: filter to generate curve-specific prompts. Furthermore, the UCS

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: incorporates a mask decoder that eliminates reliance on manual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: interaction through a dual-compression module: a Hierarchical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Feature Compression module, which aggregates the outputs of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sampled encoder to enhance detail preservation, and a Guidance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Feature Compression module, which extracts and compresses

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image-driven guidance features. Evaluated on a comprehensive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-domain dataset, including an in-house dataset covering

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eight natural curvilinear structures, UCS demonstrates state-of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the-art generalization and open-set segmentation performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across medical, engineering, natural, and plant imagery, estab-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lishing a new benchmark for universal CSS. The source code is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: available at https://github.com/kylechuuuuu/UCS.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adaptation, universal segmentation, sparse adapter.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Widely present across diverse domains, their accurate seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation is essential for many applications. In medical im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ages [3], [4], the accurate extraction of blood vessels facili-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tates the early diagnosis and monitoring of vascular diseases,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: directly impacting patient care and treatment planning. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pavement engineering [5]–[8], detecting cracks ensures struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tural integrity and operational safety, minimizing the risk and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reducing maintenance costs. Similarly, in plant biology [9],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the accurate segmentation of leaf venation enables an under-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: standing of the adaptive and ecological significance of leaf

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vein network structure, representing an essential component

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of plant phenotyping in ecological and genetic studies [10].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Although curvilinear structures across various domains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: share similar geometric characteristics, their representations

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: exhibit substantial variations depending on the specific do-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: main. This domain gap poses a considerable challenge for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structure segmentation. In this work, we use the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: term universal in a task-specific sense: a single model that can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be trained once and then applied, without architecture changes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to segment curvilinear structures across heterogeneous do-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mains (e.g., medical, engineering, natural, and plant imagery)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: universal model that can overcome cross-domain limitations is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: essential. It would enable cross-domain applications and drive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: innovation in transfer learning, open-set segmentation, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resource-efficient model deployment, while also highlighting

layout_dets.text: the remaining challenges in extending universality to even

layout_dets.text: broader modalities such as MRI or CT.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Given the need for such a universal model, we first ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: amined the characteristics and limitations of traditional curvi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linear structure segmentation approaches. These methods [8],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [11]-[16] typically require domain-specific training, and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain gap between datasets limits their direct application to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: novel domains, impeding their wider adoption for curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure segmentation across diverse fields. Additionally, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trend of large-scale models has had a profound impact across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the field of AI. The emergence of general-purpose AI models,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as GPT-4V [17], DINO [18], SegGPT [19], APE [20],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM [21], facilitates the use of foundation model to solve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multiple different downstream tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The SAM [21] marks a significant advancement in extend-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the capabilities of segmentation models, offering powerful

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: zero-shot capabilities and flexible prompting mechanisms.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Thus, many works [22]-[27] have explored the application

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of SAM in several research fields. MedSAM [23] and SAM-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Med2d [24] have explored applying SAM to medical image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation. SAM for Remote Sensing [26] has adapted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM's prior knowledge to the remote sensing domain. Al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: though these methods have achieved promising results in their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: respective domains, these methods are domain-specific and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lack multi-domain applicability.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In contrast, we propose UCS, which leverages the pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained knowledge of SAM to enable cross-domain curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure segmentation. Extensive experiments demonstrate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that UCS achieves remarkable domain adaptation capability

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through fine-tuning on limited data (3,244 images), success-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fully segmenting curvilinear structures in both seen and unseen

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domains. As illustrated in Fig. 2, UCS exhibits exceptional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: zero-shot generalization across images from diverse scenes. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: summary, our main contributions are summarized as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) We introduce UCS, the first universal framework

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for cross-domain curvilinear structure segmentation. It

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance and ro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bust generalization to unseen domains with fine-tuning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on limited data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2) We introduce an encoder built upon a pretrained im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: age encoder, featuring two key innovations: (1) Dif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ferent from one-block, one-adapter idea, the adapters

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are sparsely inserted at the encoder blocks. This Sparse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adapter inherits the SAM encoder's generalization capa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bilities and minimizes the number of fine-tuning parame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ters. (2) The Prompt Generation (PG) module integrated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a Fast Fourier Transform with a high-pass filter to extract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-frequency responses via a residual connection. It's

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designed to generate domain-adaptive initial prompts by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: exploiting frequency-domain representations of the input

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3) We propose a mask decoder that enhances feature repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentation and eliminates reliance on manual interaction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: through a dual-compression module: (1) Hierarchical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Feature Compression (HFC) module compresses the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sampled encoder outputs with an interval of 6 and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adds them to the decoder layer outputs. It provides

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-layered information, enriching the feature space

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: available to the decoder. (2) The Guidance Feature Com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pression (GFC) module employed Principal Component

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Analysis (PCA) to extract the guidance features of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder layer. It enables image-based automatic segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation and eliminates the need for manual prompts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4) Extensive experiments demonstrate that UCS achieves

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: excellent performance across multiple in-house and pub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lic benchmark datasets, confirming its robustness and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross-domain generalization.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: II. RELATED WORK

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A. Curvilinear Structure Segmentation with CNN

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Since the invention of U-Net [12], designed to integrate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: low-level and high-level information for image segmentation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: numerous U-Net variants have been proposed. Among these,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the FR-UNet [15] enhances the connectivity of U-Net seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation through a multi-resolution convolution interactive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism and a dual-threshold iterative algorithm.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Building upon U-Net, several CNN-based models have been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: optimized to achieve more accurate segmentation. Wang et

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: al. [28] integrated VGG into U-Net and enhanced the perfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mance of curve segmentation by cyclically sampling patches

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of varying sizes from the images. Xu et al. [29] proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an N-pair consistency loss function and introduced geometric

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transformation data augmentation to facilitate semi-supervised

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learning for curvilinear segmentation tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the medical field, extensive research has focused on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: developing more accurate vessel segmentation methods. Zhang

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. [30] introduces a unified multi-task learning framework

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for joint segmentation and registration, effectively enhanc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the accuracy and robustness of vessel segmentation and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: registration through a bi-fusion of structure and deformation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: at multiple scales. VSR-Net [31] leverages CNN for initial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coarse segmentation of vessel-like structures, followed by a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: graph clustering approach to dynamically rehabilitate sub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: section ruptures, thereby enhancing topological integrity and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation quality. Zhou et al. [32] proposed a backbone-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: agnostic MaskVSC method to reconstruct the retinal vascular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network by simulating missing sections of blood vessels and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using this simulation to train the model to predict the missing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parts and their connections.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the crack segmentation field, DeepCrack [33] intro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: duced a deep convolutional neural network that optimizes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: crack segmentation through hierarchical convolutional fusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of multi-scale deep features. Crack Segmentation with Super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Resolution [8] jointly learns semantic segmentation and super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolution tasks to segment cracks from low-resolution images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: By incorporating boundary combo loss to address the class

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: imbalance, CSSR achieves crack segmentation while enhanc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing image resolution. SFIAN [34] effectively models irregular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: crack objects through selective feature fusion and irregularity-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aware mechanisms, achieving pavement crack detection.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: B. Curvilinear Structure Segmentation with Transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The emergence of Transformer architectures has demon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strated capabilities in modeling long-range dependencies, of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fering promising potential to overcome the receptive field lim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: itations of CNN [35]. This characteristic has led researchers to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: explore Transformer architectures for curvilinear segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In retinal vascular segmentation, the Group Transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Network [36] includes a set of bottleneck structures that reduce

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the computational complexity of the Transformer, facilitating

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the combination of CNN and Transformer. Yu et al. [37] first

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: predicted the gamma values through CNN to adjust the in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tensity distribution of retinal images and the channel-attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Vision Transformer (ViT) enhanced edge feature maps both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatially and channel-wise. TUnet-LBF [38] integrates Trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: former Unet and local binary energy function model for coarse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to fine segmentation of retinal vessels. The Stimulus-Guided

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adaptive Transformer Network [11] introduces a hybrid CNN-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Transformer architecture with the Stimulus-Guided Adaptive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Pooling Transformer to enhance global context capture and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: suppress redundant information. This approach effectively

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distinguishes blood vessels from lesions and handles blurred

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: regions in fundus images. In crack segmentation, Qi et al. [39]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduced an end-to-end model based on ViT and level set

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: theory for segmenting bridge pavement defects, achieving

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: precise segmentation by merging the outputs of two parallel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoders.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: C. Segmentation with Large-Scale Model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: While CNN-based methods and Transformer hybrid mod-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: els excel in their trained domains, the recent push towards

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: universal models signals a shift towards large-scale model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architectures. Thus, developing vision systems that can transfer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to new concepts or domains has become a vital research

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: topic [20]. Many open-vocabulary models [40]–[42] leverage

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large pretrained multimodal models (e.g., CLIP [43]) to extract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: or transfer visual semantic knowledge. Beyond utilizing these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundational models, approaches like DenseCLIP [44] and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: GroupViT [45] demonstrate that fine-tuning these models or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training them from scratch can also yield superior zero-shot

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The SAM marks a significant advancement in extending the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: capabilities of segmentation models. As a result, SAM has be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: come a popular baseline in the segmentation domain. Several

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: works have investigated the application and adaptation of SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to different domains. SAM-Med2d [24] bridges the domain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gap between natural and medical images by fine-tuning SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on a large-scale medical dataset with 4.6 million images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and 19.7 million masks. EviPrompt [22] takes a training-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: free approach, using a single reference image-annotation pair

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to minimize labeling and computational costs. Both explore

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distinct strategies for adapting SAM to medical image segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation. HQ-SAM [25] focuses on improving SAM's capability

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for fine-grained segmentation by introducing a learnable, high-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quality output token. This token is injected into SAM's mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder and designed to predict high-quality masks, enhancing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: its ability to handle detailed segmentation tasks. Building on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM's strengths, we aim to address these gaps and explore

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: its application for curvilinear structure segmentation across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diverse domains.

layout_dets.text: III. METHOD

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: at the 5th, 11th, 17th, 23rd encoder blocks, inheriting the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM encoder's generalization capabilities and minimizing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the number of fine-tuning parameters. Furthermore, the PG

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module implements an FFT with high-pass filter to supply

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A. Image Encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The refinement of the image encoder incorporates two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: key components: the Sparse Adapter module and the Prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Generation module.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) Sparse Adapter: Adapter has proven to be an effec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive strategy for fine-tuning large models for downstream

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks [46], [47]. By eliminating the need for full-parameter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training, they preserve the model's original knowledge and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prevent catastrophic forgetting. Existing adapters are typically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designed for single-domain adaptation, limiting their ability

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to generalize across diverse domains. For example, SAM-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Med2D [24] improves segmentation performance but is limited

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the medical domain. SAM-Adapter [27] shows performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gains in shadow and camouflaged segmentation based on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets from the same domain as the fine-tuning data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To address these limitations, we propose the Sparse Adapter.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As shown in Fig. 4, unlike previous approaches [24], [27] that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: insert adapter layers into each encoder block (left side), we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: insert the adapter only at specific blocks (right side), reducing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the number of learnable parameters in the encoder backbone.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This design stems from two fundamental considerations: (1)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the requirement to prioritize learning generalized curvilin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ear patterns rather than domain-specific features and (2) the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: necessity to maintain parameter efficiency while preserving

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the pretrained encoder's generalization capacity. This will be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrated in the ablation study (Table VI).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: coherence——so its precision may not always be maximal, but

layout_dets.text: underscores UCS's effectiveness on crack-like patterns and its

layout_dets.text: V. CONCLUSION

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we introduce UCS, a universal segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model designed to segment arbitrary curvilinear structures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across diverse domains, effectively bridging the domain gap.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UCS features a novel architecture that integrates initial prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information into each encoder block and fuses multi-level

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contextual features within the mask decoder, achieving a bal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ance between global semantic understanding and precise local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: delineation. Comprehensive evaluations on both public and in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: house test datasets demonstrate that UCS outperforms state-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of-the-art CNN-based and Transformer-based models in seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation accuracy, while also exhibiting robust performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: under various image degradation conditions. By focusing on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross-domain segmentation, UCS transcends specific down-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream tasks, aligning with our goal of universal applicability.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the future, we will focus on further reducing training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parameters to achieve efficient model deployment and lower

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computational costs and explore fusing multi-modal data to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improve segmentation accuracy in complex scenarios.
